Subject: Integrata demo — initial scheduling

Hi Irene / Karthik,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the proposal. We'd like to lock in a 60-min product demo next week to walk our payments and risk teams through the flow and integration options. Proposed slot: Wed, Feb 18, 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET.

Attendees (high-level):
- Samantha Price (Integrata) — Product
- Jon Mills (Integrata) — Head of Partnerships (may join the last 15 min)
- Lisa Huang (Integrata) — Payments Ops
- Engineering lead TBD (I can add if needed)

Two asks:
1) Can you confirm if an SE will join to cover integration/SDK questions?
2) Please attach a short agenda and any pre-read (we'll share our integration doc too).

I've attached a draft agenda and our compliance checklist for context. If the time doesn't work, happy to move — we have a bit of flexibility on the 18th.

Thanks,
Samantha

Thanks Samantha — this looks great. We're excited to run through the integration flow. A quick heads-up on coverage for the proposed 11:00 AM PT slot on Feb 18: Marcus (our primary SE on this deal) is traveling that day and will be in-transit during the East-coast overlap window.

Options from our side:
- Karthik can lead the demo on Feb 18 at 11:00 AM PT and cover architecture + roadmap; Marcus can join asynchronously (recording + Q&A follow-up) OR
- Move the live session to Thu, Feb 19 at 09:00 AM PT when Marcus is back and can participate live.

If Integrata prefers live SE coverage for the full session, we recommend Thu 2/19 9:00 AM PT. If the 2/18 slot is important, Karthik will run it and Marcus will carve out time to join the Q&A at the end (or hop on for the last 15–20 mins).

I'll hold both windows tentatively — can you let us know which you prefer? I'll also attach a slimline agenda and the SOW draft for your review.

—Irene
